title: Overthinking Reduction
description: Break free from overthinking patterns with grounding techniques, thought challenging, and mindfulness

goals.title: Reduce Rumination
goals.description: Decrease time spent stuck in negative thought loops

goals.title: Improve Decision Making
goals.description: Make decisions more quickly and confidently

goals.title: Increase Present Moment Awareness
goals.description: Spend more time focused on the present

habits.title: Thought Journal
habits.description: Write down recurring thoughts for 5 minutes

habits.title: Worry Time
habits.description: Schedule 15 minutes to worry, then stop

tasks.title: Identify Patterns
tasks.description: Notice when and why you overthink

tasks.title: Create Distraction List
tasks.description: List activities to shift your focus

tasks.title: Set Decision Deadlines
tasks.description: Give yourself time limits for decisions

warnings: Overthinking is a habit that takes time to break
Be patient with yourself during the process
Some thoughts are just noise - let them pass
Consider therapy if overthinking affects daily life
fallback_message: I found an overthinking reduction template! This plan will help you break free from negative thought loops.
